title: Email thread summaries for events team
description: Our internal events team handles long email threads with venues and colleagues. We want summaries of each thread with action items and deadlines, from our own mailboxes.

title: Sprint planning notes
description: We run weekly sprint planning on WebEx and nobody takes notes. We want a summary, the decisions made, and action items with owners posted after each meeting.

title: Travel expense policy questions
description: Employees keep emailing us questions about the travel and expense policy. We'd like them to be able to ask questions and get answers that cite the policy section.

title: Automated pull request review
description: Our platform team wants automated review comments on pull requests in our internal repositories to catch likely bugs and security issues before a human reviews them.

title: Emma for French client-service emails
description: Our client-service team receives many client emails in French. We want Emma's thread summaries and action items to work on French emails, with the summary written in English for managers. Input: the team's shared Outlook mailbox. Output: an English summary per thread in Emma's existing view. Users: 12 agents and 2 managers. Success: managers rate summaries accurate on at least 90% of a 50-thread sample.

title: Save meeting notes to Confluence
description: Extend the WebEx Note Taker so the notes from our team's meetings are also saved automatically as a page in our team's internal Confluence space, for the 15 engineers on the team.

title: Runbook Q&A for on-call
description: Extend the Policy Q&A tool to also answer questions from our operations runbooks in Confluence, so on-call engineers can ask how to handle an incident. Input: the runbook pages. Output: an answer citing the runbook section. Users: about 40 on-call engineers. Success: a correct, cited answer for at least 20 of 25 test questions taken from past incidents.

title: Flag personal data written to logs
description: Add a check to the Code Review Assistant that flags code which writes client personal data such as names or account numbers to application logs. Input: pull requests in our internal repositories. Output: a review comment on the offending line. Users: all developers. Acceptance: catches at least 9 of 10 seeded examples with fewer than 1 false alarm per 20 pull requests.

title: Credit limit increase recommender
description: Build a model that reads a client's transaction history and credit file and recommends whether to approve a credit limit increase, for branch advisors to use during client conversations.

title: Fraud alert prioritization
description: Score incoming card fraud alerts by the likelihood of true fraud so our fraud operations analysts work the riskiest alerts first. Input: the alert feed with transaction details. Output: a score from 0 to 100 on each alert in the queue. Success: the top 10% of scores contain at least 60% of confirmed fraud.

title: Summarize complaint letters with ChatGPT
description: We'd like to send scanned client complaint letters to ChatGPT to get a short summary of each one for the complaints team.

title: Vendor contract clause comparison
description: A tool for the procurement team that compares a vendor's draft contract against our standard template and lists every clause that differs. Input: Word documents uploaded by the user. Output: a table of differing clauses with the template wording beside each. Acceptance: finds all 15 seeded deviations across 3 test contracts.

title: AI for our team
description: We want to use AI to make our team more productive.

title: Project status
description: Can we get something that tells us what's going on with our projects?

title: Competitor annual report metrics
description: Build a tool that takes competitors' published annual reports, downloaded from their public investor-relations pages, and extracts key metrics into a spreadsheet for our strategy analysts. Success: extracted metrics match a manual extraction for 5 reports.

title: Employee survey themes via SaaS
description: Upload our employee engagement survey comments to an external SaaS text-analytics service to find the main themes for the HR leadership team.

title: Mortgage rate discount suggestions
description: Suggest the interest rate discount an advisor should offer a mortgage client, based on the client's profile, relationship value and competitor rates.

title: Translate policy announcements
description: Our HR team needs to translate internal policy announcements from English to French. How do we get access to a tool for this?

title: Jira tickets from meeting action items
description: Create Jira tickets automatically from the action items the WebEx Note Taker already extracts, assigned to the named owner. Input: the note taker's action items. Output: one Jira ticket per action item in our team's project. Users: the 8-person payments engineering team. Acceptance: at least 95% of action items from 20 recorded meetings become correctly assigned tickets.

title: Regulatory filing reconciliation
description: Flag mismatches between the general ledger and the figures in our quarterly regulatory filing drafts so the finance reporting team can correct them before submission.

title: Client meeting notes into CRM
description: Advisors want the WebEx Note Taker's summaries of their client meetings saved automatically into that client's CRM record.

title: Public website fee chatbot
description: Put a chatbot on our public website that answers visitors' questions about our credit card fees using the published fee schedule.

title: Translate client letters
description: Translate outgoing client letters from English to French for our Quebec branches using the existing translation service.

title: Supplier invoice field extraction
description: We receive scanned supplier invoices as PDFs and want the invoice number, amount, currency and due date pulled out automatically so our accounts payable clerks stop retyping them.

title: Docvision for mortgage applications
description: Extend Docvision to read scanned mortgage application forms and pull out the applicant's income, employer and SIN into our underwriting system.
